brief.scope: (1) hardcoded-lane-value: any lane value under ops/ carried as a literal instead of read from ops/lane.conf (trunk, release branch, lane name, repo slug, worktree root, model ids, efforts, check names, security model, walls, scope cap, vendor addresses), file:line, and whether laneconf.py literals catches it; (2) defaulted-read: any conf or environment read under ops/ with a fallback value (conf.get(k, x), os.environ.get(k, x), getenv(k, x), `or DEFAULT` after such a read), file:line, key, fallback, and whether the fallback is a lane value wearing a default or a genuinely optional tuning; (3) unrouted-conf-read: any instrument or hook under ops/ that parses ops/lane.conf or reads a lane key without going through laneconf.py; (4) worker-assumption: today's `deviation assumption` records under .dev/records/dispatches, sampled as the input says, each classified as a missing input field or a judgment call.

findings.claim: hardcoded-lane-value: trunk and release are literals, not TRUNK_BRANCH/RELEASE_BRANCH. role_for treats name=="dev" as trunk and name=="main" as release; trunk_sha() resolves origin/dev or heads/dev; stacked detection excludes bases {"dev","main"}. lane.conf has TRUNK_BRANCH='dev' and RELEASE_BRANCH='master' — the census never reads master and hardcodes main. literals would match "dev" and origin/dev here but the file is in DEFERRED_LITERAL_PATHS so literals exits 0; it would not match main at all (not a NAME_KEYS token).
findings.reproduce: sed -n '217,219p;228,232p;244,245p;271p;276p;305p' ops/conductor/tools/branches.py; printf "%s\n" "---- conf ----"; rg -n "^(TRUNK_BRANCH|RELEASE_BRANCH)=" ops/lane.conf; python3 ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py literals; echo literals-exit:$?

findings.claim: defaulted-read: when laneconf is missing and LANE_CONF is unset and the tracked file is absent, lane_name() returns "agentscient" instead of refusing. key=LANE_NAME (via missing conf file); fallback="agentscient"; this is a lane value wearing a default, not optional tuning. Same four files also regex-parse the conf when the file exists (reported under unrouted-conf-read, not here). literals would match token agentscient but all four paths are deferred, so literals exits 0.
findings.reproduce: rg -n 'return "agentscient"' ops/conductor/tools/findings.py ops/conductor/tools/hand.py ops/conductor/tools/onboard.py ops/conductor/tools/decisions.py; python3 ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py literals; echo literals-exit:$?

findings.claim: defaulted-read: bash env reads with fallbacks that are lane identity, not optional empty siblings. board.sh:9 ROOT="${AGENTSCIENT_ROOT:-$HOME/projects/uscient}" key=AGENTSCIENT_ROOT fallback=$HOME/projects/uscient; board.sh:10 ORG="${AGENTSCIENT_ORG:-uscient}" key=AGENTSCIENT_ORG fallback=uscient (the org half of REPO_SLUG); link-ops.sh:9 same AGENTSCIENT_ROOT default.
